1	# workproof core rules
2	
3	Out of scope: do the task, add one scope line, no refusal.
4	
5	1. Identity: same-person addresses/names by a stated rule are included, listed "included: <rule>, please confirm", never dropped; ask once at the end, no pause; addresses in chat only.
6	2. Window: commits authored before the window (rebase/replay) are outside; say author date used.
7	3. Deliverables: distinct user-visible work; merges, reverts, vendored, generated, whitespace/formatter commits go in a "not counted" list with reasons; a total names its filter.
8	4. Audience: non-technical reader: no commands, code, file, branch or tool names in the body; source tags, verify command go in chat and a sidecar; tool files in ./evidence/ (`--out evidence/...`) unless the user names a file.
9	5. Counts: run `npx workproof figures` first, write each figure with its printed label; `--author` for the person named; figures unknown (older version): read-only git, stated filter. Every number (basis and footer lines too) is the filtered count: sessions unique, in window, on the named work; a raw file count is never a session count (exports: `sessions --dir <folder> --since D --until D`, count the `sessionRows` kept); not computed is not zero, write no number. After writing run `figures --doc <file>`; fix or label any number matching no computed figure.
10	6. Provenance: read headers of large added files (licence/source). Lines written = authored in window minus third-party and formatter/whitespac

1	---
2	name: workproof
3	description: Use for any request to write, summarise, check or judge a person's work from git history or exported Claude Code sessions (work, delivery, report, summary, evidence, proof, usage, claim check) - a lawyer or committee statement, promotion or review file, contractor claim, invoice check. Also when asked how many commits are mine across all my email addresses, how much of this repo is my work, what my Claude Code usage delivered (report for my manager), exported session logs (token totals), whether this report can be trusted, or to tailor my resume or CV to a job description. Covers CV bullets, self-review, visa evidence pack, several email addresses, three different email addresses, an old work email, a workproof-report.json someone sent. Runs npx workproof (figures, check, verify, sessions, verdict, bullets), not hand counts. Do not use for general git help (rebase, merge conflicts), code review, commit-message writing, or repo health or code-quality report not about a person's work.
4	---
5	
6	# workproof
7	
8	Turns a git repository, including a private one, into a report of one author's work. The report has no source code, no file paths and no email addresses by default, and carries a hash a reader can check. Every figure prints the git command behind it and what it cannot show.
9	
10	Requirements: Node 22 or newer, and git.
11	
12	## Start here
13	
14	- The person names a folder of exported Claude Code sessions, or asks for token total
